about: Well Wisher quest lines: optional life domains beyond study. Each level has a standard (sets x target). A level goes up only when the standard is logged on two different days. No content here is about a real person.

lines.name: Body: calisthenics
lines.why: Muscle-strengthening work on two or more days a week is the WHO adult guideline; 15 minutes at home needs no gym.
lines.safety: Stop on sharp or joint pain. Warm up for two minutes first. This is general guidance, not medical advice.

levels.name: Wall push-up
levels.cue: Body in one line, chest to the wall, elbows at 45 degrees.

levels.name: Incline push-up (hands on a table)
levels.cue: Sturdy table against a wall. Chest touches the edge.

levels.name: Knee push-up
levels.cue: Hips stay in line with knees and shoulders.

levels.name: Push-up
levels.cue: Full range: chest a fist above the floor, arms straight at the top.

levels.name: Push-up
levels.cue: Same form as level 4, more reps. Two seconds down.

levels.name: Diamond push-up
levels.cue: Hands close under the chest; elbows brush the ribs.

levels.name: Archer push-up
levels.cue: Per side. One arm bends, the other stays almost straight.

levels.name: Towel row (door)
levels.cue: Towel around a closed door's handles, lean back, pull chest to the door. Check the door is locked and solid.

levels.name: Inverted row, knees bent (under a sturdy table)
levels.cue: Only under a heavy table that cannot tip. Squeeze shoulder blades at the top.

levels.name: Inverted row, legs straight
levels.cue: Body rigid like a plank.

levels.name: Dead hang (pull-up bar)
levels.cue: Needs a bar. Shoulders active, not shrugged into the ears.

levels.name: Negative pull-up
levels.cue: Jump to the top, lower for five slow seconds.

levels.name: Pull-up
levels.cue: From a dead hang, chin over the bar.

levels.name: Pull-up
levels.cue: Same as level 6, more reps.

levels.name: Assisted squat (hold a door frame)
levels.cue: Hips back, heels down, as deep as is comfortable.

levels.name: Bodyweight squat
levels.cue: Thighs at least parallel, knees track the toes.

levels.name: Split squat
levels.cue: Per leg. Back knee lowers to just above the floor.

levels.name: Bulgarian split squat (rear foot on a chair)
levels.cue: Per leg. Front shin stays roughly vertical.

levels.name: Assisted shrimp squat
levels.cue: Per leg, holding a wall for balance.

levels.name: Plank
levels.cue: Forearms under shoulders, glutes squeezed, no sagging hips.

levels.name: Plank
levels.cue: Same form, longer hold.

levels.name: Tuck hollow hold
levels.cue: Lower back pressed into the floor, knees to chest.

levels.name: Hollow hold
levels.cue: Legs and arms extended, lower back still on the floor.

levels.name: Side plank
levels.cue: Per side. Body in one straight line.
